sourceMeaning: to spend time with other people in order to enjoy yourself, for example at a party
example: At weekends, I like to socialise with friends at a café.

sourceMeaning: to feel sorry about something that has happened and to wish that it could have been different/better
example: I regret missing the concert and wish I had gone.

sourceMeaning: with an unpleasant smell
example: Please take those smelly socks out of your bag and wash them.

sourceMeaning: being larger, most important or having more influence than others
example: The main reason for our visit is to see our grandparents.

sourceMeaning: interesting (and often famous) place that visitors go to see
example: The old castle is a famous sight that many tourists come to see.

sourceMeaning: something that makes people want to visit a place because it is interesting or enjoyable
example: The new water park is a popular attraction for families.

sourceMeaning: the whole number or amount when two or more numbers or amounts have been added together
example: The sum of five and seven is twelve.

sourceMeaning: someone who comes from another country
example: As a foreigner, he enjoyed learning about the local language and customs.

sourceMeaning: (for the police) to take someone to a police station in order to ask them about a crime that they believe they might have committed
example: The police may arrest someone they believe has committed a crime.

sourceMeaning: something that is extremely surprising to someone
example: The magician's trick was so unbelievable that we could hardly trust our eyes.
